title: Wheelset Assembly Instructions
intro: This guide outlines the standard procedure for assembling our wheelsets, ensuring durability, safety, and optimal performance.

preparation.title: Preparation
items: Inspect all components to ensure they are intact (rim, hub, spokes, nipples).

We use our self-developed semi-automatic wheel truing stand, which allows centering adjustments without the need for a dishing tool, together with the Xieda spoke tension meter and several other tools we have designed ourselves.

lacing.title: Lacing the Wheel
items: Insert the spokes into the hub flange according to the selected lacing pattern (e.g., 3-cross). To avoid scratches, use a dedicated lacing jig.
Thread the spokes through the rim holes in sequence, alternating inside and outside spokes to maintain balance.

nipples.title: Installing Nipples
items: Screw the nipples onto the ends of the spokes, tightening them lightly at first.
Ensure all spokes are correctly seated in both the hub and rim, with the lacing pattern properly aligned.

note.jBendBody: follow SHIMANO's standard orientation for inside/outside placement.
note.straightPullBody: the lacing is fixed and determined solely by hub design.

tensioning.title: Tensioning the Spokes
items: Gradually and evenly tighten the nipples, working around the rim in multiple passes.
Use a tension meter to check spoke tension, slowly narrowing the tension differences on the same side.

truing.title: Truing the Wheel
items: Place the wheelset in the truing stand (our proprietary truing station ensures precise centering).
Adjust spoke tension to correct lateral deviations (side-to-side) and radial deviations (up-and-down).
Check the dish (rim centering relative to the hub) to ensure proper alignment.

stressRelief.title: Stress Relief
items: Perform stress relief using appropriate equipment, typically 3-5 times, until spoke tension and trueness remain stable without noticeable changes.
If tension or trueness shifts after stress relief, continue adjusting and repeat the process until stability is achieved.

finalInspection.title: Final Inspection
items: Confirm uniform spoke tension and apply low-strength threadlocker to ensure long-term stability of the wheelset.
Spin the wheel to check for smooth rotation and proper centering.
Install rim tape and, if required, mount the tire.

measurementStandards.title: Measurement Standards
measurementStandards.body: All measurements must be quantified using standard tools. Subjective feedback such as "visual impression" will be considered technically unreliable, and the company reserves the right to deny after-sales service in such cases.
